plainTranslation: The classic chemistry contact. The Venus person feels wanted and pursued; the Mars person feels the pull and goes after it. Physical, immediate, hard to sit still around each other. Failure mode: mistaking heat for foundation - the attraction is real but says nothing about whether you can live together. Enjoy the spark, build the rest deliberately, and check what's under it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
